objective: Pre-register and build the harness for a two-arm visual CRT state-fidelity measurement: does the engine's SWEEP/DISPLACEMENT/EXPANSION/RETEST classification at a marked bar correspond to what an independent observer can see on a TradingView chart? Two arms (bare chart vs. the same crop with the engine's h_ref/l_ref drawn, states never shown) separate the already-measured level-visibility confound (5/84 sweeps align tightly with a production SMC level; 51/84 touch none) from genuine classification disagreement. Event-anchored sample of all 111 engine transitions plus matched silent-bar controls. Research/docs only; grants no G001 and no authority (CLAUDE.md 6.5).
affected_models: none — no model is read, retrained, or re-registered. F-076's 6 stale families stay exactly as stale as they already were.
affected_production_config: none — configs/production/ACTIVE_VERSION stays v2_htfcrt_2026_08. The pinned corpus data/XAUUSD_M15.csv is READ ONLY and is NOT re-fetched. Engine events are read from results/htfcrt_1month_parent_wired/run_20260816_011239_XAUUSD/; per-bar range levels from results/crt_survey_trace/20260815T062829Z/trace.jsonl. Both are fail-closed on state-sequence disagreement.

pre_registration.ritual: CLAUDE.md 6.2 Epistemic Integrity Pre-Registration (Program E-001). Frozen in docs/research/preregistration-visual-crt-state-fidelity.md BEFORE any item image is generated and BEFORE any label is collected.
pre_registration.questions_are_trader_language: V1-V4 are frozen in trader language with no CRT vocabulary and no engine thresholds. A rule-card that asked 'did the high exceed h_ref while the close came back below it' would make the labeler a slow computer and measure nothing. The definitional collision is the measurement.
pre_registration.two_arms_are_mandatory: Arm 1 = bare 48-bar crop. Arm 2 = identical crop plus two unlabelled neutral horizontal lines at the engine's h_ref/l_ref. States are never shown. The load-bearing number is Arm2-Arm1 kappa delta on V1 SWEEP. Without the two arms the experiment mostly re-measures the already-known level-visibility confound (reports/monthly_tv_vs_active_production_semantic_comparison.md: 5/84 tight SMC, 51/84 no SMC).
pre_registration.controls_are_mandatory: All 111 STATE_TRANSITION events plus ~111 action==NONE controls matched on session and candle-range percentile. Without controls only agreement on engine-positives is measurable; events the engine missed are undetectable.
pre_registration.insufficient_cells_declared_now: The month contains 2 RETESTs and 6 EXPANSIONs. Under the <15 minority-class rule those cells cannot produce a result at any effort. DISPLACEMENT n=19 is marginal. Only SWEEP n=84 can carry a real number. Declared before any label exists so a thin cell cannot later be presented as a null (E-001: underpowered != negative).
pre_registration.join_is_timestamp_never_index: Ground truth joins on timestamp. candle_index bases differ by a constant per-run offset (crt_state_confusion_matrix.remap_event_indices_to_ohlcv exists for exactly this). 100% of items must resolve by timestamp or the run aborts.
pre_registration.config_consistency_fail_closed: The events artifact and the trace artifact come from different runs. State sequences must agree on every shared timestamp before they are used together. The known 85-vs-84 sweep delta is one sweep inside the 78-bar backtest warmup and is not a mismatch. Disagreement elsewhere aborts; do not reconcile by hand.
pre_registration.new_finding_condition: A new F-id is registered ONLY IF Arm 2 is also low (state logic diverges from an observer given the same level) AND the user-adjudicated ceiling on that question is >= 0.5. A clean measurement that confirms the already-known level-visibility confound is NOT a discovery. Findings decision is gated (CLAUDE.md 6.2) — results are brought before any finding is edited. Default is no new F-id.
pre_registration.verdict_vocabulary: Anything read off pixels is a VISUAL claim under the smc_visual_verification.py:19-30 split: never self-certifies; renders the evidence and stops. Headline verdict is RENDERED_PENDING_HUMAN_ADJUDICATION, bounded by the measured LLM-vs-human ceiling. Never a column called TradingView_state — TradingView declares no state. Closed CLAUDE.md 6.8 set only. different != wrong.
pre_registration.arm_independence: Arm 1 and Arm 2 must be labelled by different cold subagents. Reusing one agent across arms anchors Arm 2 on Arm 1 and destroys the delta. Subagent blinding is procedural, not mechanical (disclosed). The user-adjudicated ~30-item subsample is mechanically blind and is the reliability ceiling; bulk numbers are reported as a fraction of that ceiling.
